Dialogs.Dialog: Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
Do you watch much TV, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hm？ It's not that I never watch it？
So you don't watch much, then.
I watch movies fairly often, though.
Like, DVDs？
Yes. And I read books, I guess.
I see. But that seems like you.
Ah, but there's a show I like too.
Eh？ Which program？
The late-night foreign movie program. Sometimes they show old movies, so it's fun, you know？
That's...
Ah, that's a movie too. Yeah, I guess I'm more into movies than TV.
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
Is there a food you especially like, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I like everything, but... if I had to pick... throat lozenges？
...So, candy？
No, I'm not especially into regular ones.
So throat lozenges are special.
Maybe it's become a habit.
Is your throat delicate？
No, not really. I got hooked on them once, and it just stuck.
True, they're hard to get tired of.
Hehe, something like that. Sorry for the boring answer.
(That's plenty unusual...)
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
Come to think of it, is there a sport you like, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Huh？ Ah... why？
Just curious. Anything？
No, I'm an indoor type through and through.
What about going swimming in summer？
Huh!? Ah, well... not really, I guess？
You don't go to the beach or the pool？
It's not that I don't go... don't laugh, okay？
Hm？ I won't laugh.
Swimming is a little... for me... ahh, embarrassing.
(No need to be that bothered...)
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
Do you listen to music much, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
No, not much. When I do, it's movie music... I guess？
Huh, movie music.
I often buy the soundtracks of movies I like. They're surprisingly good, you know？
Could it be you even buy soundtracks for movies you haven't seen？
With obscure movies, that happens, I guess？ They won't show them around here.
Huh, even obscure movies have soundtracks.
Hehe. The world of movies is deep, you know？ For example...
(Did I just flip a switch...？)
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
Come to think of it, do you have any hobbies besides horror, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Horror is... a hobby, I suppose, but that's not what you mean, right？ Hmm.
What's wrong？
You won't tell anyone？
？ Yeah, I won't.
You see... wrappers.
Wrappers？
I collect throat lozenge wrappers.
I don't really get it myself, but I'd often forget to throw them away after eating, and I ended up collecting them. I'm on my fourth binder.
In binders...
Sorry. Did that creep you out？
No, I was just surprised.
Of course I'm not doing it seriously, but for some reason, it's kept going.
It's become a habit.
Yes, more of a habit than a hobby. At this point.
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
Do you like animals, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yes. Most of them. Though I'm a little bad with cows and horses.
Cows and horses？
That drool is a bit... you know.
Then, what's your favorite animal？
Um... tanuki, I guess？
Tanuki？
Yes. I like how roundish they are, and they're charming. And I kind of relate to them.
Relate？
I'm a bit of an airhead, so maybe I'm a little tanuki-like.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... a tanuki!?)
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
I might have asked before, but what's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s dream for the future？
Hehe. Do you want me to say "to be a certain someone's bride"？
I had a little feeling you might.
But... a bride, I think. After all.
Really？
Is it strange？
No. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a wedding dress... would look amazing, I bet.
Hehe. What I want to wear isn't a wedding dress, it's an apron.
An apron？
Standing in the kitchen, soothing a baby, welcoming my husband home... that kind of thing.
...That might suit you even better.
Hehe. You might get to see it in a few years, you know？
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
Do you have a dream for the future, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hmm, let's see...
Like becoming a horror writer？
No way. I could never be a writer.
Really？ Even though you read so many books？
No. It's because I read so many that I can tell.
I don't seem to have much drive to create.
Don't you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Like, wanting to see a certain kind of horror？
It's not that I don't, but...
Ever thought of making it？
Hmm... no, I can't see myself going that far.
I see, that's a bit of a shame. I'd be interested in a horror story made by ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hehe. If you're that interested, how about some horror that isn't mine？
(Ugh, I poked the beehive.)
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
Is there a woman you look up to, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hmm... I've never thought about that...
Meaning you're confident in yourself？
No, that's not it. It's just...
Just？
You know, admiring someone means seeing something in them that you don't have, right？
Now that you say it, I guess？
Yes, exactly. So in my case, I end up thinking about how to make what I lack my own.
So that's why you don't have anyone you look up to？
Yes. My interest goes to the missing thing, not the person.
I see...
No. I was just thinking I made the right call making this person my girlfriend.
Geez... springing that on me is unfair, you know？
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
Is there a woman ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks up to？
Only women, huh.
Same sex and opposite sex are a bit different. Anyone？ A woman you'd want to be like.
Hmm... I don't think there's anyone like that？
If anything, I can't be anyone but me... is that a bit too pretentious？
You know how people often talk about their "true self"？
Searching for a true self different from now, awakening to your true self...
Yeah, there's stuff like that.
Don't you think that's really irresponsible toward the self you are now？
I want to do my best as myself. But that looks easy and is hard... so that me is who I look up to, I guess？
Huh...
...What？
You're kind of cool right now, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Huh？ Ah... stop it.
Geez... dummy.
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
Is there a woman ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks up to？
What's this, all of a sudden？
Like... a female horror writer you look up to.
Well... there are people I respect... but I wouldn't say I look up to them.
I see...
But why are you curious？ I read somewhere this kind of question is to probe someone's insecurities. Were you trying that？
Really？ I didn't mean that at all.
No, I'm not bothered. Besides, if it's you, I'd forgive you even if you were.
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
What kind of movies do you like, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Horror, after all？
Of course！ But recent horror isn't that good.
Really？
With more CG, the visuals feel lighter. They're slowly getting better, but...
CG makes the visuals lighter？
Yes. Compared to old movies... the atmosphere, I guess？ It's different.
So you like ones without CG better？
Hmm, some movies can only be made with CG, but... I prefer the analog feel, I guess.
Analog... somehow ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems bad with machines too.
Ah, geez！ I'm sensitive about that！
(Hit the nail on the head, huh...)
Hey.
Anegasaki
What？
You read fast, don't you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ How much do you read？
My reading pace？ About ten books a month... I guess？
One every three days？ Amazing.
That's not much, you know？ Amazing people read three a day.
At that point it's uncharted territory.
I couldn't do that much. I want to watch movies too.
Yeah.
Yes. ...And lately, something else is taking up my time.
No, never mind. Just talking to myself.
